summary: Plumas County summit lookout: first station 1911 (a June 1910 item says 1910), rebuilt 1915, 1934 and 1986 with microwave relays; NHLR-registered 2019.

facts.design: 1986 replacement building housing microwave relays; earlier 1934 BC-301 cabin; the 1915 building is a two-story building in one newspaper and a probable short tower in the Register

corrections.why: The 1915 replacement is described as two stories and a 1950 item calls the station a two story wood structure. No source read describes three stories. The current 1986 building is not described, so its story count should be verified before the record is final.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The Register says a probable short tower on a standard plan; a 1915 newspaper says a larger two-story building, and a 1950 item says two stories. The story reports both and leans on the newspaper accounts.

A June 1910 item says a station was established; the Register dates the first structure to 1911. Not fully resolved. The story uses the 1911 date for the first built structure and reports the 1910 item.
The Register gives 7,234 ft; an October 8, 1938 Lassen Advocate item in the weebly compilation gives 7,254 ft. The story uses the Register figure.

notes_for_editor: No current access rule, visit report or rental listing was in the two pages read (NHLR detail page and the weebly compilation). The NHLR staffing statement is undated, so as_of is 'undated'. The StoryMaps Lost Sierra Route page returned no text. The 1913 weebly item describes starting work on a station, which may be a precursor of the 1915 building; not used in the story. Attribute the dated newspaper items to the weebly compilation, not to the original papers, which were not read. Budget: about six page reads were used on this tower; no further reads were attempted.
